description: This file contains a JavaScript implementation of a date picker widget, including template rendering, date parsing/formatting, layout management, and event handling. It defines a DatePicker class with methods for initialization, showing, hiding, setting, getting, and clearing dates, and includes a templating function.

classes.name: DatePicker
classes.description: Main class providing date picker functionality with methods for initialization, display, and date management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the date picker on selected elements with options.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the selected date(s) in the date picker.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Retrieves the selected date in formatted or raw form.

methods.name: fixLayout
methods.description: Adjusts the layout of the date picker.
